newsitem.title: USA: CellStar adopts stockholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: CellStar adopts stockholder rights plan.

text.p: CellStar Corp said Tuesday its board had adopted a stockholder rights plan.
The plan creates a dividend of one right for each outstanding share of common stock.

The rights do not become exercisable or trade separately from the common stock unless someone acquires 15 percent or more of the common stock, or a tender or exchange offer is made for 15 percent or more of the common stock, the company said.
Each right entitles the holder to buy 1/1,000 share of Series A preferred stock at an exercise price of $80 per share.
The distribution of rights will be made to stockholders of record January 9, CellStar said.
CellStar is a wholesale distributor and retailer of cellular telephones and related products.
